offending_extra_words: Customer's obligation to pay all amounts due is not damages and is not limited by this Section.
reasons: Operation 1 completes the preferred cap with a minimal operator/number substitution: it correctly rebases limb (a) on "fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim" (removing the illusory "Fees ... under the first Order Form" anchor) and adds the USD 1,000,000 limb as a greater-of.
All preferred carve-outs and the mutual consequential-damages exclusion were already present in 21.2–21.3 and were left untouched.

Operation 2 was unnecessary: the existing sentence ("Customer's obligation to pay undisputed Fees for conforming Services is not damages") already satisfied the preferred element that Customer payment obligations are not damages, so no edit was needed to complete the selected level.

Operation 2 also worsens our position by deleting the "undisputed" and "for conforming Services" qualifiers, exposing Customer to uncapped liability for disputed amounts and amounts invoiced for non-conforming Services — an unrelated commercial protection that should have remained effective.

Note only in the rationale: limb (a) now uses lowercase "fees" rather than the defined term "Fees", which is deliberate (the definition is the USD 12,000 implementation charge) but should be flagged so it is not later conformed back to the defined term.
